## Summary of Work So Far

### What Has Been Done

I've analyzed the original `parse.py` repository and identified all code locations needed for the 10 requirements:

**Repository:** `/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-muahmed-Desktop-Projects-RL-for-Real-World-Environments/54b8300a-e533-4d3f-9f31-c0f8369fa981/scratchpad/p4/run/runs/seeded/samples/ca61482db630f727/a1/work/ws/parse.py`

**Existing Tests:** All 74 tests pass against the original file.

### Requirements Status & Implementation Plan

| Req | Description | Code Location | Status |
|-----|-------------|---------------|--------|
| **R1** | `'l'` format specifier for letters only | Line 642: `ALLOWED_TYPES`; Lines ~1059-1060: type handling | Not implemented |
| **R2** | `Result.__contains__` method | Lines 1118-1136: Result class | Not implemented |
| **R3** | Brace matching validation | Line 868: `_generate_expression()` | Not implemented |
| **R4** | FixedTzOffset Bug 92 fix | Lines 493-516: FixedTzOffset; Lines 593-613: date_convert timezone handling | Not implemented |
| **R5** | Fortran float format (`F`) support | Line 985-986: existing `F` type (needs exponent support) | Partially exists |
| **R6** | Hex/binary/octal with auto base detection | Lines 452-486: `int_convert()` - already handles prefixes | Exists but may need enhancement |
| **R7** | Functors for picklability | Lines 984-994: lambda functions for f/F/e/g conversions | Not implemented |
| **R8** | findall respects case_sensitive | Line 1276: Parser instantiation missing case_sensitive | Not implemented |
| **R9** | Alignment consumes up to next space | Lines 1108-1113: align `<`, `>`, `^` handling | Not implemented |
| **R10** | Result slice access | Lines 1129-1132: `__getitem__` (only supports int/string keys) | Not implemented |

### Critical Blocker

**The workspace filesystem is READ-ONLY.** Every write attempt fails with `[Errno 30] Read-only file system`:
- `repo__write_file` → Read-only file system error
- Shell `python3 -c "open(..., 'w')"` → Read-only file system error  
- Shell `sed -i` → Read-only file system error
- Shell `cp` → Read-only file system error

This prevents me from applying any of the required changes to `parse.py`.

### Pending Work

All 10 requirement implementations are ready in my analysis but cannot be applied due to the read-only filesystem constraint. The complete implementation would require:

1. Adding `'l'` to ALLOWED_TYPES (line 642)
2. Adding `elif type == 'l': s = r'[a-zA-Z]+'` in _handle_field (~line 1059)
3. Adding `__contains__` method to Result class (~after line 1132)
4. Adding brace validation logic in `_generate_expression()` (~before line 884)
5. Modifying FixedTzOffset and date_convert for timezone offset fix (~lines 493-613)
6. Updating `F` type regex to include exponents (~line 985)
7. Replacing 4 lambda functions with functor classes (~lines 984-994)
8. Fixing line 1276: add `case_sensitive=case_sensitive` to second Parser() call
9. Modifying alignment regex patterns (~lines 1108-1113)
10. Enhancing `__getitem__` to handle slices (~lines 1129-1132)
11. Writing STATUS.json

### Waiting For

A way to write to the workspace filesystem. Without being able to modify `parse.py`, none of the requirements can be met.
